name: Architecte Martien
description: Commandant de peloton coordonnant les assauts frontaux avec des formations de combat martiennes classiques.

subject.archetype: Martian Hegemony Purist Commander – The Martian Architect

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy, smooth carapace plates in carmine red, angular shoulders with asymmetrical half‑cape in dark grey, integral helmet with opaque visor and thin horizontal red slit, tight ballistic fabric underlayer with martial cut
loadout.arsenal: Electromagnetic railgun with rectangular/octagonal barrel, thermal energy sword with red‑glowing, smoky blade, optional sidearm plasma pistol

attitude.behavior: Standing upright on a jagged platform, surveying the battlefield, issuing hand signals to a formation of Martian troops, blade held low, railgun ready
attitude.emotion: Cold, disciplined focus, mask‑like stoicism behind the visor, commanding presence exuding relentless resolve

palette_names.name: Carmine Red
palette_names.role: Primary dominant color, armor and main surfaces

palette_names.name: Dark Grey
palette_names.role: Secondary tone, underlayers, half‑cape, structural elements

palette_names.name: Bright Red Neon
palette_names.role: Accent highlights, visor slit, plasma glow, reactor exhausts

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic directional light from a harsh overhead sun with strong rim lighting on armor edges, subtle red neon reflections from nearby reactor cores

camera.angle: Low angle, slight Dutch tilt to emphasize power and aggression

scenography.setting: Barren Martian desert battlefield, jagged basalt formations, massive monolithic red‑grey command bunker in background, hexagonal grilles embedded in the ground
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thin dust haze, faint red glow from thrusters, occasional spark particles from railgun discharge, distant sandstorms with red‑lit sky
